intersections.note: Hopple (printed HOPPLE (BRIDGE AV.), 60 ft) ends at Moosewood; Moosewood is 60 ft north of Hopple (running NNW off the top edge) and 50 ft south of it. Point = Hopple's axis at the mean of Moosewood's two axes
Western (50 ft) continues north off the top edge (sheet 521). East of Western the street is printed BRIDGE (IRON BRIDGE) AV.

Linden starts here and runs south; block 1 is unbroken north of South Hopple. Linden's west face is off the sheet: centre 25 ft (Linden 50 ft) left of its east block line, which matches the water pipe in Linden. South Hopple continues west (sheet 517)
South Hopple ends at Western (east side of Western unbroken)
Linden centre 25 ft left of its east block line; Pulte continues west on sheet 517
Pulte ends at Western (water pipes meet in a T here)
Denham NOT IMPROVED (50 ft) west of Western; continues west on sheet 517

Western bends here (more nearly SSE south of Denham). Denham is 50 ft and NOT IMPROVED west of Western (Western's west line runs dashed across its mouth) and 40 ft east of Western, where its axis sits ~10 ft further north. Point = mean of the four axis crossings
CUMMINGS ST. (40 ft) starts at Denham and runs SSE; only its first ~400 px are drawn (sheet 520 has the rest). Same junction as sheet 520 (887,342)
Holliday is PRIVATE CLOSED, 30 ft; whether it continues west of Linden cannot be seen (west side off the sheet, not on the key map)
Holliday (private, closed) ends at Western; Western's west line runs dashed across its mouth

Linden is 50 ft north of Carll and 25 ft south of it (label 25'; same on sheet 519), keeping its west line, so its axis jogs ~70 px; point = mean of the two Linden axes on Carll's axis. Both west faces are off the sheet

Western is 50 ft north of Carll and 40 ft south of it (south leg runs straight down the sheet at x 5630-5880 toward Baltimore); Carll's lines east of Western sit ~13 ft north of those west of it. Point = mean of the four axis crossings. Same crossing as sheet 519 (94,2072) and sheet 520 (405,2407)

alleys.note: 10 ft alley marked (Closed), from Linden to Western between Pulte and Denham
labelled PRIVATE ALLEY (11 ft), from Pulte south to the closed alley

ends.note: Denham (40 ft) stops at the C.H.&D. railroad near the right edge; same end as sheet 520 (1697,190)

notes: Sheet is north-up. Linden runs down the left edge (west face off the sheet; the strip left of x~120 is the binding/facing page). Western Av. crosses diagonally from Hopple at the top to Carll at the bottom right; it bends at Denham. The cross street printed 'HOPPLE ... SOUTH' (HOPPLE at the west end, SOUTH in larger type in the middle) is recorded as South Hopple Street, to keep it apart from Hopple St. (Bridge Av.) at the top. Moosewood is 60 ft north of Hopple, 50 ft south of it (width list gives 50). Denham is 50 ft west of Western (NOT IMPROVED) and 40 ft east of it (width list gives 50). Linden is 50 ft north of Carll, 25 ft south of it. The C.H.&D. tracks along the right side are ignored; the line east of Western at y~3830 is a property line, not a street.
